questions.q: What are the three Windows Firewall profiles?
options: Domain, Private, and Public
Inbound, Outbound, and Local
Basic, Advanced, and Enterprise
Home, Work, and School
questions.explain: Windows Firewall applies one of three profiles — Domain, Private, or Public — depending on the trust level of the current network.

questions.q: Why might a laptop stop responding to file-sharing requests the moment it connects to airport Wi-Fi?
options: The firewall automatically switches to the more restrictive Public profile, which can have that inbound rule disabled
Windows Firewall turns off entirely on any new network
File sharing is permanently disabled once BitLocker is enabled
Public Wi-Fi networks block all outbound traffic by default
questions.explain: The firewall profile changes automatically based on network trust, and the Public profile is the most restrictive by default.

questions.q: What is the default posture for inbound traffic under Windows Firewall?
options: Blocked unless a rule explicitly allows it
Allowed unless a rule explicitly blocks it
Always allowed, with no exceptions possible
Inbound traffic is not evaluated by the firewall at all
questions.explain: Inbound traffic is blocked by default — software that needs to accept incoming connections usually needs its own inbound rule created.

questions.q: What does Microsoft Defender Antivirus's real-time protection do?
options: Continuously scans files as they're opened, run, downloaded, or modified, rather than waiting for a manual scan
Only scans files once per week on a fixed schedule
Only scans files larger than 1 GB
Replaces the need for any firewall rules
questions.explain: Real-time protection is continuous and automatic, acting the moment a file is touched rather than requiring the user to run a scan.

questions.q: What does cloud-delivered protection add on top of real-time protection?
options: Near-instant classification of unknown files against Microsoft's cloud threat intelligence, catching brand-new threats faster than a local signature update could
A way to disable real-time protection safely
Automatic encryption of all downloaded files
A second, slower antivirus engine that runs once a month
questions.explain: Cloud-delivered protection checks unclassified files against Microsoft's broader cloud intelligence, closing the gap before local signatures catch up.
